bull_bear.body:
- Commissioned a new 65-bed hospital at Thandla, District Jhabua, improving accessibility to quality healthcare in the region and equipped with modern infrastructure
- Installed a state-of-the-art CT Scan machine, described as enabling better imaging quality, faster processing and improved diagnostic efficiency
- Installed a new robotic machine for surgical procedures, cited as allowing enhanced precision, reduced patient recovery time and improved clinical outcomes
- Expanded outpatient departments (OPDs) and associated facilities to handle increasing patient inflow and offer comprehensive services under one roof
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

business.body: The Company operates multispecialty hospital and diagnostic services in Madhya Pradesh, having acquired the entire running business, assets and liabilities of M/s Shah Hospital, the sole proprietorship concern of Promoter Dr. Kirti Kumar Shah, under a Business Transfer Agreement dated December 31, 2022. It serves patients across clinical specialities including orthopedics, general surgery, gynecology and obstetrics, general medicine, pediatrics, dental and radiology. During the year it broadened its offering by commissioning a new 65-bed hospital at Thandla, District Jhabua, and by adding advanced diagnostic and surgical equipment including a CT scanner and a robotic machine.

outlook.body:
- Strengthen infrastructure, technological capabilities and service delivery mechanisms to enhance patient care and broaden healthcare offerings
- Expand geographic reach through the new multispecialty hospital at Thandla, District Jhabua (M.P.), equipped with high-technology CT Scan machine
- Upgrade diagnostic capability — CT Scanner installed and installation of a Siemens Magnetom Essenza 1.5T MRI Scanner (TIM + DOT Technology) commenced
- Adopt advanced surgical technology (robotic machine) to position the Company at the forefront of technological innovation in healthcare
- Expand outpatient departments (OPDs) and associated facilities to handle rising patient inflow and offer comprehensive services under one roof
- Improve market position by focusing on technologically advanced and more profitable product and market segments, and working aggressively on productivity, efficiency and cost reduction
- Pursue collaborations and tie-ups with corporate organisations, government schemes such as Ayushman Bharat, and insurance companies for cashless treatment (stated as an opportunity)
- Explore medical tourism for cost-effective robotic surgeries, a training and research centre for robotic surgery and advanced diagnostics, and digital healthcare / preventive health check-up programmes (stated as opportunities)
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: During FY2025-26 the Company commissioned a new hospital with a capacity of 65 beds at Thandla, District Jhabua - 457777 (M.P.), described as a strategic expansion aimed at improving accessibility to quality healthcare services in the region; the facility is equipped with modern infrastructure and multi-facilities including a high-technology CT Scan machine. The Company strengthened its diagnostic infrastructure by installing an advanced CT Scanner with state-of-the-art imaging technologies, and installed a new robotic machine for surgical procedures. It also commenced the installation of a Siemens Magnetom Essenza 1.5T MRI Scanner (TIM + DOT Technology), which management expects to further expand diagnostic services and contribute to future growth and revenue. Separately, the Company undertook expansion of new OPDs and associated healthcare facilities to accommodate increasing patient inflow and provide comprehensive services under one roof. No rupee capex quantum, timeline for the MRI commissioning, or funding detail is disclosed in the routed text.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Huge demand for healthcare services in the domestic as well as overseas market
- New Thandla facility is designed to meet the growing demand for specialised medical care in the region
- Rising patient inflow driving the expansion of OPDs and associated facilities
- MRI scanner installation expected to further expand diagnostic services and contribute to the Company's future growth and revenue
- Availability of low-cost, skilled human resources
- Proactive government thrust on reforms, with further liberalisation under process
- Government schemes and insurance cashless tie-ups can significantly boost patient volumes and revenue streams
- Margin pressure from high costs of medical equipment, maintenance and consumables, and rising human-resource costs for doctors, specialists and paramedics
- Pricing pressure from increasing competition from corporate hospital chains and specialised clinics, and more cost-conscious patients preferring government schemes or budget hospitals
